_doc: Units. side 'player' = yours (built at your Nodes and captured cities), 'native' = the homeworld factions' armies, 'structure' = a settlement's walls (not a real unit). speed = movement points per cycle; sight = vision radius; upow = base Unit Power (battle strength); energy = Energy allocated while the unit exists (never consumed). domain: 'land' walks, 'air' ignores terrain and crosses water, 'sea' sails water hexes. attack = can start fights; capture = can take an undefended city by moving in; oneShot = destroyed after its strike; requires = tech that unlocks it. Art: assets/art/unit_<id>_idle.png, 64x64 per frame, 4 frames in one row.

units.name: Observer Drone
units.blurb: Recon. Flies over anything, sees far, cannot fight.

units.name: Bastion Tank
units.blurb: Heavy armour. The backbone of a siege.

units.name: Tidewarden
units.blurb: Autonomous warship. Built at coastal settlements; shells anything next to the water.

units.name: Shrike Jet
units.blurb: Strike fighter. Fast, strong, cannot hold ground.

units.name: Lance Missile
units.blurb: One strike, then gone. Cracks garrisons.

units.name: Walls
units.blurb: A settlement's own defences. They fight when no unit is there to; their UPow comes from rules.json (walls).
